newFindings.title: Type with many members
newFindings.rationale: Large types often become aggregation points for unrelated behavior.

architecture-review.json.review: Existing Process receipt-reader boundary and persistence owner, original-only accepted admission/child/material checks, no new project or DI edge, transaction, lock or provider invocation. Existing live fingerprint expression preserved. Current assignment repair cannot supply or remove original selected authority; historical dispatch always false. PostgreSQL timestamp precision reconstructs original stored fingerprint. Validation pending. The new informational12-member query-owner finding is reviewed as cohesive: shared source construction plus explicit historical entry, no parallel owner. Three direct Release production builds and Integration pass; full portability15647 unchanged and exact107 discovery pass. Existing190 scoped diagnostics remain; direct builds provide compilation evidence.

validation.failures: One supersession fixture used a UOW without canonical database; two query tests incorrectly rejected the required prepared-launch PayloadJson; four registered-reader fixtures fabricated operator authority and were rejected before observation. Production gates held. Repair one test file, then repeat30 new cases with exact source bridge.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: Original source candidate passed100/107. Seven failures are retained and under review; fixture canonical root funding and prepared-launch payload expectations are among them. Historical cleanup denials remain unchanged.

fingerprint-compatibility.json.historicalTimestampPrecision: Npgsql PostgreSQL epoch-relative microsecond round trip; actual SQL cases at +7 and -7 ticks
